examples_0601

When all replacement strings are palindromes, the resulting L-system pattern will have mirror symmetry, which helps create more compelling image. In nature, most animals (including humans) display bilateral symmetry.

Consider the replacement rules below.

A > ++C+BB+C+B
B > A+AACAA+A
C > A-AAC++CAA-A

For each replacement rule, is the replacement palindromic?

  • Does A > ++C+BB+C+B have a palindromic replacement?

  • Does B > A+AACAA+A have a palindromic replacement?

  • Does C > A-AAC++CAA-A have a palindromic replacement?
